senses.gloss: मूर्त- + मात्र मूर्त- + मात्र, n. only corporeal, Bhāṣāp. 157.
मूर्ति- + मात्र मूर्ति- + मात्र, f. a minute substantial portion, Man. 1, 19.

† मुर् मुर्, i. 6, To circle, to surround.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. mūrus.
मुर मुर, m. The name of a Daitya killed by Viṣṇu.

मुरज मुरज,
 I. m. A small drum, Mālav. d. 21.
 II. f. जा.
 1. A large drum, Kumāras. 6, 40.
 2. The wife of Kuvera.
मुरला मुरला, f. The Narmadā river, Utt. Rāmac. 50, 2.
मुरली मुरली, f. A flute.
मुरलीधर मुरली-धर, m. Kṛṣṇa.

मुर्छ् मुर्छ् (akin to मृ and म्लै), i. 1, मूर्छ, Par.
 1. To be faint, to lose consciousness, Rām. 2, 34, 17.
 2. To increase, to grow vehement, Ragh. 12, 57 (Calc.).
 3. To be frequent, Śāk. 66, 4.
 4. To fill, 6, 9 (Calc.).
 5. To be a match for, 2, 34 (Calc.); to be powerful, Śāk. d. 191 (to appear in a looking-glass).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मूर्छित.
 1. Fainted, Vikr. 54, 17; insensible, Rām. 2, 34, 17.
 2. Stupid.
 3. Intoxicated, MBh. 3, 1864.
 4. Infatuated, Chr. 37, 27; bewildered, Lass. 7, 10.
 5. Increased, grown.
 6. Tall.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिमूर्छित, Intoxicated, infatuated, MBh. 1, 7794.
 --With वि वि, विमूर्छित, Wrapped (Stenzler), Yājñ. 3, 75.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To increase, Kir. 5, 41.
 2. To be powerful, Ragh. 16, 64 (Calc.).
 --Caus. To cause to faint, Utt. Rāmac. 47, 2.
 --Cf. Goth. untila-malsks, foolish.

मुर्मुर मुर्मुर, m.
 1. A fire of chaff.
 2. The god of love.
 3. A horse of the sun.
† मुर्व् मुर्व्, i. 1, मूर्व, Par. To bind, to tie.
मूर्ख मूर्ख, i. e. मुर्छ् + अ, m. A fool, a blockhead, Vikr. 33, 2.
मूर्खता मूर्ख + ता, f., मूर्खत्व मूर्ख + त्व, n., and मूर्खिमन् मूर्खिमन्, i. e. मूर्ख + इमन्, m. Stupidity, Pañc. iii. d. 246; 127, 14.
मूर्छता मूर्छता, i. e. मुर्छ् + अ + ता, f. Denseness, Vikr. d. 48.

मूर्छन मूर्छन, i. e. मुर्छ् + अन,
 I. n. Modulation, Rām. 1, 4, 11.
 II. f. ना.
 1. A melody, Megh. 84.
 2. A tone as placed in its scale, the seventh part of a scale, Lass. 39, 9; Pañc. iii. d. 43.
मूर्छा मूर्छा, i. e. मूर्छ् + अ, f. Fainting, loss of consciousness, Utt. Rāmac. 58, 7; Pañc. 35, 10 (instr. by fainting, i. e. fainted).
मूर्छाल मूर्छा + ल, adj. Fainted.

मूर्त मूर्त (akin to मूर्ति), adj., f. ता.
 1. Solid, material, corporeal, Bhāṣāp. 86; 157; Utt. Rāmac. 60, 7.
 2. Embodied, incarnate, Śāk. d. 32; Kathās. 3, 62.
 --Comp.
मूर्तत्व मूर्त + त्व, n. Corporality, Bhāṣāp. 24.

मूर्ति मूर्ति, probably better मूर्त्ति, i. e. मृद् + ति, cf. Man. 12, 120.
 1. Matter, substance, Man. 1, 17; hard substances, Man. 12, 120 (Jones: the terrene parts of the human body).
 2. [] Figure, form, Bhartṛ. 2, 1; Pañc. ii. d. 169.
 3. Body, Rājat. 5, 364.
 4. Incarnation, Man. 1, 98.
 5. Image, Man. 2, 225.
 6. Beauty, Pañc. ii. d. 107.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. perhaps βρέτας and μορϕή.
मूर्तितस् मूर्ति + तस्, adv. = abl. sing. of मूर्ति, Man. 1, 55.

मूर्तिमन्त् मूर्ति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती.
 1. Having shape or substance, embodied, Utt. Rāmac. 13, 4.
 2. Incarnate, Hit. 100, 2; Śāk. d. 112.
 --Comp.
मूर्धज मूर्धज, i. e. मूर्धन्-ज, m. Hair, the hair of the head, Śāk. d. 29.

मूर्धन् मूर्धन्, m. The head, Pañc. 184, 10.
 --Comp.
मूर्धन्य मूर्धन् + य, adj. Cerebral (rather lingual).
मूर्ध्वन् मूर्ध्वन्, m. The head.
मूर्वा मूर्वा, f. A sort of creeper, Sanseviera zeylanica, from the fibres of which are made bowstrings and the girdle of the Kṣatriyas.
मूर्ति- + संचर मूर्ति- + संचर, adj. embodied, Utt. Rāmac. 145, 12.
